title: Retouching that keeps your own features
description: Control the light and the local corrections, comparing the result with the original portrait.

blocks.text: A person needs to remove a temporary detail or fix the light while keeping their own features. A blanket “improve the face” command leaves too many decisions to the algorithm.

quote.text:
This is still my go to for eliminating small flaws without making me unrecognizable. 

Love!!!

blocks.text: Carrying the edit through to a result

The changes are applied one at a time: light, a local edit, the strength of the effect. A comparison with the original is available at every step. Freckles and moles are not removed automatically along with the temporary detail that was chosen.
Where the idea has an advantage

It is worth testing a few specific jobs on different portraits first. This can be a mode of an existing editor: a separate app has to give more control, not one more version of blanket automatic retouching.
